text: Under a bounded/sandboxed run, global home-tier config and skill discovery (e.g. ~/.claude settings and skills) is not auto-loaded, so the agent cannot re-widen its scope via ambient configuration.
title: Under a bounded/sandboxed run, global home-tier config and skill discovery (e.g. ~/.claude settings and skills) is not auto-loaded, so the agent cannot re-widen its scope via ambient configuration.
